logic.note: Active-low (optocoupler LED from VCC through 1 kΩ to IN) or active-high (IN through 1 kΩ to a transistor base) input; turns on above 0.8 mA of input current.

timing.note: Contacts switch 10 ms after the input turns on and 5 ms after it turns off (datasheet maximums for SRD-class relays); no contact bounce.

analog.note: Coil 70 Ω (~71 mA at 5 V); pulls in at ≥ 3.75 V and drops out below 0.5 V. Closed contacts are 0.01 Ω.

power.note: Coil and power-LED current on VCC; warns above the 10 A contact rating. AC mains loads are not simulated.

emulates: Coil pull-in voltage (no click on 3.3 V)
COM–NO / COM–NC switching of a DC load
Partial turn-on of active-low modules from a 3.3 V GPIO (warning)
doesNotEmulate: AC loads, arcing and contact wear
Inductive kick from the load (put a diode across DC motor / pump loads)
testOnRealDevice: Which level your module switches on (silkscreen or H/L faber)
That the module turns fully off from a 3.3 V board
Mains wiring: only with a proper enclosure and someone qualified; this simulation does not check it
